have h_inj_on : Set.InjOn a ↑s := by
  rintro i hi j hj h
  suffices i = j by assumption

  revert h
  fin_cases hi <;> fin_cases hj <;> simp_all [h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅]

let f := fun t ↦ ∑ i in s, x i * |t - a i|

have hf_eq_one : ∀ i ∈ s, f (a i) = 1 := by
  intro i hi; fin_cases hi <;> simp_all [f, hs₀, h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, abs_of_ne_zero]

let p := s.sort (fun i j ↦ a i ≤ a j)
have hp_len : p.length = 4 := by simp [s, hs₀]
have p_mem : ∀ i, i ∈ p ↔ i ∈ s := by simp [s, hs₀, p]
have p_nodup : p.Nodup := by simp [p]
have p_sorted : p.Pairwise (fun i j ↦ a i < a j) := by
  refine List.Pairwise.imp_of_le (Finset.sort_sorted_le s _) fun {i j} hij h_eq => ?_
  exact (h_inj_on (p_mem i) (p_mem j) h_eq).elim hij

let p₀ := p.get ⟨0, by simp [hp_len]⟩
let p₁ := p.get ⟨1, by simp [hp_len]⟩
let p₂ := p.get ⟨2, by simp [hp_len]⟩
let p₃ := p.get ⟨3, by simp [hp_len]⟩

  have h := List.pairwise_iff_get.mp p_sorted
  simp only [hp_len, Fin.mk_lt_mk, and_self] at h
  rcases h with ⟨h01, _, _, h12, _, h23⟩
  exact ⟨h01, h12, h23⟩

  refine continuous_finset_sum s fun i _ ↦ ?_
  exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_id'.sub continuous_const)))

  have hf_diff := DifferentiableOn.mono f DifferentiableOn.abs ?_
  replace hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo (a p_left) (a p_right)) := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.sum; intro i hi
    refine DifferentiableOn.const_mul ?_ (x i)
    refine DifferentiableOn.abs_sub_const ?_ (a i)
    exact differentiableOn_id
  apply deriv_eq_zero_of_is_const_on_Ioo h_ord_interval
  apply IsConst.of_eq
  rw [hf_eq_one p_left (p_mem p_left), hf_eq_one p_right (p_mem p_right)]
  all_goals assumption

  have t_not_mem_a_s : (a p₀ + a p₁) / 2 ∉ a '' s := by
    intro h; rcases h with ⟨i, hi, h_eq⟩
    rw [hs_mem] at hi; fin_cases hi <;> { subst i; simp at h_eq; linarith [h_ord.1, h_ord.2.1, h_ord.2.2] }
  rw [← deriv_f_at (has_deriv_f_outside_a _ t_not_mem_a_s)]
  apply deriv_eq_zero_on_interval <;> simp_all [p_mem]

have x_p₀_eq_x_p₃ : x p₀ = x p₃ := by linarith

  rw [hf_eq_one p₀ (p_mem p₀), f, Finset.sum_list_of_nodup p_nodup, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
